# INV-001 for 50.00 CAD, paid in full from C001's credit.
#
# The credit is the one `a_customers_credit_made_by_a_journal_entry.txt` makes,
# stated by its transaction's guid and its credit split's guid.
#
# What this fixture produces: INV-001 posted, its lot holding the credit split,
# and the journal entry's other split in no lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_unpost_leaves_a_journal_entry_whole.py.
invoice "INV-001"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 50
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 50.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-01-06
		txn_guid: "a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1"
		txn_split_guid: "b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1"
